caseName: Gloucester Cnty. Sch. Bd. v. G.G. ex rel. Grimm
caseNameFull: GLOUCESTER COUNTY SCHOOL BOARD v. G.G., By His Next Friend and Mother, Deirdre GRIMM.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted limited to Questions 2 and 3 presented by the petition.
